notes.page_account: The letter continues a proposed reduction to homotopy types, anticipates translation of the six operations into this framework, and considers a tame morphism with compatible equisingular stratifications. It proposes a morphism of diagrams of manifolds with boundary, then describes four operations on constructible sheaves and induced maps on unions of strata. These are manuscript proposals, not results proved here. The final sentence continues after doivent.
